name: 5-bromotryptamine
summary: 5-Bromotryptamine (5-Br-T; developmental code name PAL-518) is a serotonin receptor modulator and monoamine releasing agent of the tryptamine family. It is the 5-bromo derivative of tryptamine.

pharmacology.text: 5-Bromotryptamine (5-Br-T; developmental code name PAL-518) is a serotonin receptor modulator and monoamine releasing agent of the tryptamine family. The drug acts as a potent full agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, with an EC50 of 5.14 nM and an Emax of 108%. It is also a potent full agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2B receptor.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonin–dopamine releasing agent
